{{Quote|Have you ever heard of the Nharl system?''"<br />"''No.''"<br />"''There were five planets around the local sun. One of them was my homeworld, Equanus. You know why you don't see many Equani in the galaxy, Jos? It's because there are only a handful of us left&mdash;a few hundred, maybe a thousand at most&mdash;of a species that once numbered almost a billion. And do you know why there are so few of us now? It's because only those of us who were offworld two years, six months, and three days ago survived.|[[Klo Merit]] and [[Jos Vondar]]|<ref name="JH" />}}
The '''Nharl system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]], within the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Nharl]] was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the system.<ref name="TCSWE-Nharl" /> It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by five [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Equanus]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Equani]].<ref name="JH" />
